scripts.// dev: Vite dev server with HMR at http://127.0.0.1:8080 (kills stale listeners first). /api is proxied to the optional sync backend; run `bun run dev:api` alongside if you need it
scripts.// dev:api: Runs only the review-state sync API (server.ts) on :8081, for the Vite dev server to proxy /api to
scripts.// start: Production-like: assembles the SAME dist/ bundle Netlify deploys (build:netlify), then serves it plus the sync API from server.ts
scripts.start: bun run build:netlify && bun run serve
scripts.// serve: Serves an already-built dist/ plus the sync API, without rebuilding
scripts.// validate: Zod-validates pages/*.js and js/page-data.js for schema shape and business invariants
scripts.// audit-cards: Reports card titles/text that differ from the destination page Karl actually renders. Read-only report, never a gate — the text half needs a per-card human decision. Manual, not part of build or CI.
scripts.// export: Generates data/page_inventory.{json,csv} and syncs the local tracking sheet
scripts.// ingest: Chunks docs/source/**/*.md, embeds via Gemini, and upserts into knowledge_chunks. Needs GEMINI_API_KEY. Manual, not part of the build pipeline.
scripts.// sync-tracking: Re-generates the local mockup tracking CSV sheets
scripts.// push-tracking: Pushes the local page review status to the Google Sheets tracker
scripts.// build: Full pipeline: validate -> export -> build workshop form -> bundle the app -> publish the form into dist/ -> emit the self-contained single-file page
scripts.build: bun run validate && bun run export && bun run build:workshop-form && bun run build:app && node build_scripts/copy-workshop-form.js && bun run build:singlefile
scripts.// build:app: Vite production bundle into dist/ (what server.ts and Netlify serve)
scripts.// build:singlefile: Inlines every script and stylesheet into one portable dist-singlefile/index.html
scripts.// build:workshop-form: Installs dependencies and runs Vite production build for the embedded mosquito request sub-form
scripts.build:workshop-form: bun install --cwd forms/mosquito-workshop-request && bun run --cwd forms/mosquito-workshop-request build
scripts.// build:netlify: Validates page data, bundles the app into dist/, and publishes the committed workshop form into it
scripts.build:netlify: bun run validate && bun run build:app && node build_scripts/copy-workshop-form.js
scripts.// format: Runs Prettier to automatically format all files in place
scripts.// format:check: Checks files for formatting compliance with Prettier (acts as the project's linter)
scripts.// test: Runs the test suite using Bun's test runner
scripts.test: bun test tests/utils.test.js tests/data-validation.test.js tests/page-render.test.js tests/csv.test.js tests/review-state-schema.test.js tests/reading-level.test.js tests/plain-language.test.js tests/page-import-checks.test.js tests/review-merge.test.js tests/review-api-server.test.js tests/review-state-sync.test.js tests/decision-vocabulary.test.js tests/knowledge-chunking.test.js tests/knowledge-search.test.js tests/validate-compliance-audit.test.js tests/doc-counts.test.js tests/mockup-image-export.test.js tests/review-insights-data.test.js tests/review-insights-charts.test.js tests/review-insights-render.test.js tests/review-ops-data.test.js tests/ai-assist-schema.test.js tests/ai-assist-env.test.js tests/ai-assist-providers.test.js tests/ai-assist-server.test.js tests/ai-assist-validate-rewrite.test.js
scripts.// test:e2e: Playwright end-to-end tests (builds, then serves dist/ on :8080)
